theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U m) (y : Euclid P), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen U → y ∈ regularSet T → HasMassDensity T y 1 → ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ball y ρ₀ ⊆ U ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ ρ₀ → ∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m (T.support ∩ ball y ρ) ∧ IsOrientation m (T.support ∩ ball y ρ) ξ ∧ μHE[m] (T.support ∩ ball y ρ) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball y ρ → T ω = ∫ x in T.support ∩ ball y ρ, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]
